en.title: Nvidia announces Jensen Huang’s reinstatement as CEO
en.summary: On November 23, 2026, Nvidia announced that its board of directors had unanimously voted to immediately resume Huang’s duties as president, CEO and director. Previously, the board of directors had many communications and talks with Huang Renxun and recognized Huang Renxun’s candid attitude and leadership capabilities. During the decision-making process, the board of directors listened to the opinions of senior U.S. government officials and determined that Huang's reinstatement would not pose a national security risk. Harvey C. Jones, Chairman of the Board of Directors, will continue to serve as Chairman. He said that Huang Renxun is the right person to lead Nvidia, and his reinstatement is in the interests of shareholders, employees, partners and customers. At the same time, he thanked Colette Kress for her efforts as interim CEO, and Colette Kress will continue to serve as Nvidia's chief financial officer. In early 2014, a few months before graduating from the University of Derby, Brammer applied to join the then-new ID@Xbox programme. ID@Xbox is an independent game developer support program officially launched by Microsoft in 2014. Through it, budding developers can present project proposals to Microsoft and will have the opportunity to receive two Xbox One development machines and a license to use Unreal Engine for free. "I've wanted to make my own games since I was 11 years old, and I had done mods for Battlefield," Bramer recalled. "So when I filled out the application, I made up my resume and claimed that I had been employed by a number of well-known studios, including Lionhead. Take-Two's publishing brand 2K also confirmed that Firaxis is reorganizing and that studio head Heather Hazen will also leave. A 2K spokesperson also revealed that Firaxis will reduce the size of its team during the reorganization, and its future focus will still be on the design, technology and player experience of strategy games. When it comes to the part of the person in charge, Hazen, 2K said that Hazen believes that it is appropriate to take over now to ensure that the next person in charge can fully lead the reorganized team. Heather Hazen joined Firaxis in 2020. Previously, she worked at PopCap and Epic Games.

This trend is also common around the world. Statistics released by GDC in November 2026 show that 40% of game practitioners surveyed will use generative AI at work, and 57% of them use it every day. GDC statistics also show that 62% of educators allow, encourage or require students to use generative AI in homework, but only 20% of students have actually used it.
